Regarding the network SVG's:

If we have A -> B (A granger causes B) and B -> C, but only A and C is in the list of genes in the top 5% of genes.

Therefore I have visualized both scenarios, you can find information about each network (Number of nodes and edges) in each of the note.txt files.
